title: Resident Trust Fund Accounts — Holding Terms and Deposit Availability
content:
These are the terms on which Keystone Ridge holds a resident's own money under the Resident Trust Fund Accounts. They are identical in all six tiers: Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Self-Directed; Medicaid Representative Payee; Medicaid Guardianship; Non-Medicaid Self-Directed; Non-Medicaid Representative Payee; and Non-Medicaid Guardianship.

| Term | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Funds held only on a written authorization of the resident or legal representative | Yes |
| Depositing funds may be made a condition of admission | No |
| Resident funds kept apart from the center's operating accounts | Yes |
| Fee for holding or managing the account | None may be charged |
| Sources a deposit is accepted from | the resident's cash; a family member's check; Social Security benefits the center receives as representative payee; a pension paid by direct deposit; a refund from the center |
| Hold on a deposited personal check before it can be withdrawn | 5 business days |
| Posting of a benefit received as representative payee | within 1 business day of receipt |

## Notes on the terms

**Business days.** The check hold and the benefit posting period count business days: Monday through Friday, excluding bank holidays. A Saturday, a Sunday or a bank holiday never counts toward the 5-business-day hold.

**Same-day availability.** Cash, direct deposits and benefits are available on the day they are posted; only a deposited personal check carries the 5-business-day hold.

**No fee, no condition.** Because no holding or management fee is permitted under any tier, a statement never carries such a fee, and an admission never depends on whether the resident opens an account.
